jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite animation sheet, same original character as supplied reference 10.jpg: tall athletic purple-skinned male dark elf, long flowing silver-white hair, pointed ears, intricate purple-black spiked armor with violet gems, two curved jagged purple swords (one attached to each hand), two purple bat wings. Preserve character proportions/material detail and crisp hand-painted pixel-art fantasy RPG style. TRUE transparent RGBA background, no checkerboard, no white background, no text/grid/labels, no ground shadow. Exactly 12 full-body separate sprites arranged uniform 4 columns x 3 rows on landscape canvas. Every sprite fits entirely in its own equal cell with generous empty margins, all wing tips/swords/particles inside cell; no crossing cell boundaries. Same camera, scale, body height and baseline; tiny controlled wing flex, not flying. Row1 four walk keyframes: left contact, passing, right contact, passing. Row2 four genuinely distinct dual-sword melee attack keyframes: wind up both swords, first sweeping cut with shoulder/torso rotation, second crossing cut with compact violet trails, recover into low ready stance. Hands and blades change positions clearly, never merely add glow to one pose. Row3: two casting poses (charge violet rune then release compact violet pulse), two hurt poses (recoil then recover). Keep both swords attached to hands during all actions. Show all 12 poses and no extra character.
DIRECTION REQUIREMENT: All 12 characters face camera in consistent 3/4 FRONT view towards screen bottom; see face and breastplate.
